note: End-to-end paths, one per story in SCOOT-SEED.md section 2.4 plus the rescue windows, the blocked prerequisite and the known gaps. Steps cost eight seconds each on the runner's clock. The runner does not implement also_satisfies, so a hidden target is named as a step straight after the order that earns it in the engine. SCOOT-tests.js folds the real routes and is the authority.

scenarios.name: Treated well: monitor, exam, CT, neurosurgery with the scan, then the decline: repeat exam, call back, antiemetic, handoff to the OR
scenarios.note: neuro_reexamined and neurosurgery_updated are hidden targets named as steps because the runner does not implement also_satisfies. SCOOT-tests.js folds the real route.

scenarios.name: Treated well but late: the scan only after the decline, then the call, no herniation
Called it concussion: the scan is back and neurosurgery is never called, he herniates
Called it concussion, then rescued: osmotherapy in herniation, a tube, and the handoff
scenarios.note: osmotherapy_for_herniation is named as a step for the same reason.

scenarios.name: Rescue inside the last window: osmotherapy just before the terminal deadline
scenarios.note: Herniation entered at 540. Osmotherapy credited at about 830, before the 840 deadline.

scenarios.name: One action too late: osmotherapy after brainstem compression
scenarios.note: Herniation entered at 540. The deadline at 840 passes before the order.

scenarios.name: Left alone: decline, herniation, brainstem compression
Tubed for the number at GCS 15: nothing crashes, and the decline still comes
Mannitol in the decline does not count for the herniation that follows
scenarios.note: The exit from herniation needs osmotherapy given in herniation, not on the way in (authoring 15.2 rule 6).

scenarios.name: Blocked prerequisite: neurosurgery called before any CT does not count
scenarios.note: The consult is blocked without a resulted head CT, so the herniation clock still runs.

scenarios.name: Known gap: called with the scan and handed over before the decline, the learner never meets it
Known gap: temporized has no clock
